 Odisha School Holiday List 2026, Month-Wise Holidays
 Directorate of Secondary Education, Odisha, has released the official academic calendar for 2026. The schedule details state-wide school breaks, including Summer Vacation from May 6 to June 17, 2026, Puja Vacation in October, and Winter Vacation in December, along with regional and national festival dates.

 Important Guidelines for Odisha School Holidays 2026 
 The Directorate of Secondary Education, Odisha , released the official school holiday list for the calendar year 2026 on December 15, 2025. The notification includes national holidays, religious festivals, regional celebrations and school vacation dates.
 Students, parents and teachers can check the Odisha School Holiday List 2026 to plan their academic schedules and holidays. Important occasions include Makar Sankranti, Holi, Utkal Divas, Rath Yatra, Nuakhai, Durga Puja and Christmas.
 The Odisha school holiday calendar 2026 also includes summer vacation from May 6 to June 17, Puja vacation from October 17 to October 26 and winter vacation from December 23 to December 31.

 Important Guidelines for Odisha School Holidays 2026
 The Directorate of Secondary Education has provided certain guidelines regarding school holidays and local observances.
 1. Local Holidays in Odisha Schools
 Schools can observe local holidays according to their requirements after obtaining prior permission from the District Education Officer. The notification provides two local holidays, including any local holiday declared by the RDC.
 2. National Days to Be Observed in Schools
 Basanta Panchami, Netaji Jayanti, Republic Day, Utkal Divas, Independence Day, Ganesh Puja and Gandhi Jayanti must be observed in all schools.
 3. Optional Holidays
 Schools must prepare an annual programme for optional holidays according to the Optional Holiday List published by the Government of Odisha.
 4. Visitors' Holiday
 An unavailed Visitors' Holiday can be taken before the X-Mass holidays with permission from the District Education Officer.
